form_title: 2010 FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES (Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5)

reports.report_type_printed: Seven days preceding the Primary Election
reports.notes: Handwritten. NOTATION: the filer writes cents as a raised/superscript pair after the dollars ('550' with a superscript '00', '2,703' with a superscript '70') and prefixes each cell with a hand-drawn '$'; transcribed here in ordinary decimal form with the '$' dropped, exactly as written otherwise (line 6 has no thousands comma on the page, lines 1-2 do). Lines 3 and 5 are written over earlier digits - the pen has been retraced through the middle zeros/fives - so 3000.00 and 3550.00 are recorded at medium confidence as the surviving values; nothing was arithmetic-derived. The summary page's own last-name and Date of Report header boxes are blank; report_date is the cover-page signature date.
